title: Complete genetics/body owner: all eighty sections, source corrections and later carrier reconciliations
head: be24c225c00cf8c583bf7773ee124d354b91e88b

reviews.classification: full genetics/body palette reconciled; source tiers, local mechanisms and dated engineering proposals preserved
reviews.disposition:
All1837 pre-fold lines were read in twelve150-line ranges plus37, including G1–G80, all PH/GN/SG/LQ/AG/CN/BD/CL/BP/MX/HI/MS/PR/TR/SB/WR/OB/BM/RP/BSR/EV/EM/TM/PG/UI/SO/GM/GD/MC/MI/LA/BC/MG/MB/MH/MP/SS/SP/SI/ST/SC/CV/CA/OV/IM/CB/CC/AB/FD tables, rounds10–14 and all B94–B127 follow-through. Earlier B124 selected-range review is now full-owner coverage. Linked source and implementation packets receive no new full-read credit by this promotion. This remains a palette with dated code observations, not a present inventory of missing or implemented mechanics. Later root corrections qualify earlier examples and build-order suggestions; current PROJECT, AD32/AD42/AD51/AD52 and domain owners govern selected work.

G1–G16 retain genetics, constitution, bloodline, anatomy, adaptation and identity as useful distinctions, not compulsory panels or a universal biological model. A sample, a dormant template, an expressed organ, learned coordination, taught knowledge, a soul faculty and an institutional title are distinct carriers. A physique can confer a powerful complete function without a balancing flaw, compulsory training or weak starting stage. A bloodline need not be DNA or pedigree purity; adopted/school/pact/soul/relic transmission can coexist with reproduction. Compatibility follows actual mechanisms rather than matching labels. G2's original gene-thief and source-specific Warhammer candidate remain different: the bounded official introduction/retrospective does not establish arbitrary gene looting, a complete era/lifecycle or psychic control model. No fresh canon, medical or biological claim is verified here.

PH/SG/AG/LQ and G19/G24/G25 separate physiology, reproductive role, identity, presentation, address, registry claim and cultural expectations. The old bio.gender migration/default species assignment and race/height multiplier proposal are not a selected migration or proof those old sources are unchanged. Their effects need actual consumers and an explicit compatibility decision. SG11 dimorphism, AG maturity and ordinary-extreme physiology remain local/reference-qualified examples, not claims that identity determines capacity or a universal real-world medical simulation. Body realism and harshness are different dials. Different bodies can use aids or other means without compulsory cure; a learned skill may remain useful across a body change even when a particular movement needs adaptation. Sex/gender/attraction, NPC agency and adult-person romance follow their actual owners rather than a global player filter. Small characteristics can be texture without a modifier, and silence about a quirk does not prove its absence.

BD/CL/BP/MX, G30 and RL keep ancestry, actual faculty, office, family claim, knowledge, bequest and continued self separate. The old first-prestige gate is retired, and G30 is not thereby implemented or selected. The later B107 correction acknowledges card-specific carryCheats and estate/history owners, qualifying blanket no-faculty-carry statements without claiming arbitrary bloodline/soul transfer. B3 offers/coefficient/caps are illustrative. Strong inherited or mixed faculties need no forced conflict, concentration decay, impairment, antipathy or population takeover. BP's heading “only a bloodline” names these examples, not a ban on another mechanism producing the same function. Biological inheritance does not silently carry learned mastery, allegiance, every ancestor's memory, property or consent. Clones, descendants, borrowed bodies, avatars and continuing consciousness preserve separate identities. Family likeness and a test are evidence with scope; an institutional certificate is a separate legal consumer.

TR/SB/WR/HI/BM/RP/EV/EM/TM and micro MI–SC retain actual training, recovery, exposure, treatment, resource, clock and state transitions. Old-injury weather, disease detection, heredity, critical windows and other real-world inspirations are design suggestions, not reliable medical facts established by this text. A world can support exact supernatural sensing, complete immunity, clean editing, no detraining or no upkeep; the examples do not require side effects, degeneration, hunger death, regression loss or secrecy tells. LA9's statistics alone do not identify a hidden causal constitution. BSR tells do not universally detect lies. A learned clue, current state, stale diagnosis and narrator belief differ; a hidden change cannot reveal itself merely through an unjustified “stale” UI label. Ordinary own-native stats remain accurate under AD8; SI3/CV1/AB12's fuzzy or biased windows require an actual in-world measuring means and do not reclassify native UI as false. Pure flavor cannot assert a fictional event that never happened, but real sensation/texture needs no penalty or new maintenance bar.

SO/GM/GD/MC retain sourcing, access, custody, purity, freshness, compatibility, production and recipient effects as distinct. GM8 already corrects gene-seed to a production-system reference, not one generic host-rewriting organ. GD3 separates clinic complexity, recipient metabolism, active energy and equipped loadout; its budget is local, not a universal genome cap. CV/CA/CC retain reading versus changing, copy/drain/borrow/bestow, stored information versus usable means and world-specific source backing. The example weak/temporary/fuel-limited copied bloodline is one variant, not compulsory weakening of every copy. A potent means can reveal what it actually supports without an automatic error tax or immunity counter. Comic CB13 editorial redating is not bodily stasis; origin retcon, lived memory, current causal truth, mantle and cloned body remain distinct. Source-era/memory disclaimers and later B17/B124 corrections qualify earlier comic generalizations; no exact comic issue or source capture was re-read here.

AB/IM/MT/FD/ST-A–F and OW preserve one truth owner with typed extensions, real action adapters for costs, separate knowledge projections, stable drawn results/revisions, frozen creation inputs, actual full-envelope storage accounting and shared tolerance/source records. They are candidate schemas and historical code observations, not a required new genome engine, mandatory two-implemented-world prerequisite or universal body-record-first program. AD51 qualifies the old “two real consumers” hard gate: design the first useful shared seam with known differences and validate/revise on another actual world. Invalid body.gen/body.modify stream suggestions remain corrected by existing stream families rather than revived. Do not regenerate permanent outcomes from mutable tables or infer saved truth from a rolling log. Demand for deeper NPC detail is not permission to disclose it; frozen parent inputs prevent later changes rewriting a child's creation, while future genuine development remains possible. The old10000-person/10MB estimates and32-memory-entry observations are not current measured capacities. About15cards/world/1000cards is explicit speculative volume, not minimum content or authority to launch bulk writers. AD42 makes human samples optional feedback rather than a hard release gate.

Current AD16/OD4/TBANK and AD52 qualify the dated offline-span formulas, single-clock shorthand and reading/rest-first proposals. Supported active/away work uses actual local/body clocks and owned state, pauses at consequential choices or exhausted means, and can be compressed without erasing useful outcomes or requiring per-tick narration. Local clocks can differ through mechanisms; there is no universal silent wall-clock aging, offscreen population growth, forced per-effect timer or lost body training on every return. FB1–FB6 retain the corrected donor evidence: neither named reincarnator source was shown to roll birth traits; Immortal Life's bounded cohabitation read did not prove marriage/heirs or absence elsewhere; Path of the Idle Cultivator paths, physiques and roots are separate; separate fields do not prove separate behavior. The old P01-next sentence, uncommitted branch snapshots and old hero-picker recommendation are history, not a current execution order. Preserve the future body, lineage, care, research and quiet-life ideas without selecting a new social/genetics wave. No present runtime gap, gameplay effect, source qualification, browser behavior, save migration or installation is established by this full document review.
reviews.evidence: All1837 current lines read in twelve150-line chunks plus37, no truncated slice. Current AD/OD4/TBANK authority consulted; linked source/runtime/private bodies not exercised.
reviews.reopen: Inspect current body/capability/knowledge/custody/clock and actual acquisition/application/transmission consumer for the selected case; source and implementation gaps remain individually scoped.
